### Install Tab Shelf

Available for Chrome and Edge. Add it to your browser in one click from the store.

02

### Open the side panel

Click the Tab Shelf icon in your browser toolbar. Your tabs appear instantly in a clean vertical list.

03

### Take control of your tabs

Organise, filter, group, and search your tabs — all without leaving the page you're on.

### Grouping rules
